# HyperPhysics

> A comprehensive physics reference resource covering classical mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, relativity, and optics with interactive educational content.

HyperPhysics is an educational physics website maintained by Georgia State University that provides reference materials and explanations of fundamental physics concepts. It serves as a learning resource for students and educators exploring classical and modern physics topics through detailed concept maps and cross-referenced materials.

## Key Topics

- Gauss' law
- Coulomb's law
- Electric field
- Moment of inertia
- Rotational motion
- Angular momentum
- Time dilation
- Lorentz transformation
- Wave-particle duality
- Snell's Law
- Lorentz force law
- Quantum mechanics
- Special relativity
- Electromagnetism
- Optics

## Electromagnetism & Field Theory

- [Electric field](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/electric/elefie.html): Electric field reference covering Coulomb's law, Gauss' law, and field theory
- [Electric Field, Spherical Geometry](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/electric/elesph.html): Electrostatics reference for spherical electric fields using Gauss' law and Coulomb's law

## Quantum Mechanics & Modern Physics

- [Wave nature of electron](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/Bohr.html): Quantum mechanics reference on electron wave nature, Bohr model, and DeBroglie wavelength

## Relativity & Spacetime

- [Time dilation/length contraction](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/Relativ/tdil.html): Special relativity reference on time dilation and length contraction via Lorentz transformation

## Mechanics & Rotational Dynamics

- [Moment of Inertia](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/mi.html): Reference guide to moment of inertia in rotational dynamics and angular momentum

## Optics & Wave Phenomena

- [Refraction of Light](http://hyperphysics.phy-astr.gsu.edu/hbase/geoopt/refr.html): Optical physics reference covering Snell's Law and light refraction principles
